Although we approach markets with scientific rigor and systematic strategies, we recognize that markets are inherently human, necessitating adaptable strategies and agile tactics.

At Square Kettle, markets are our medium - but our edge comes from the way we process information. Through a blend of game theory, data science, and years of trading expertise, our engineers always stay one step ahead.

Charles Darwin once said: "It is not the strongest of the species that survives, nor the most intelligent that survives. It is the one that is the most adaptable to change." We believe in the same. The markets are volatile, and their regimes often shift on a whim; we strive to be flexible and constantly adapting.

In Square Kettle, we operate in a highly collaborative and integrated environment, where units are expected to relay data and provide feedback across the floor. Within the firm, we believe in constructive competition, which means we support individuals who have the drive to outperform others, but do so with integrity and ethics. Ultimately, we are a group of passionate individuals who simply wish to solve the market puzzle.
In normative competitive markets, research isn't just about having an edge… it's applying it.

Markets shift in real time across the entire globe and asset classes. We trade when opportunity arises - from equities and options to futures derivatives - we use a combination of global reach, local insight, and quick execution.
Our approach balances return objectives with rigorous downside protection. We size positions prudently, diversify across instruments, and emphasize capital preservation in adverse regimes.

Our employees combine the computing power of technology with a solid foundation in market fundamentals to assess markets in a global derivatives manner that integrates data and psychology, resulting in trading strategies with holistic consideration.
Our footprint spans from Chicago, New York, and Tainan, allowing us to engage in markets all around the clock.
Risk is treated as a first-class input: we monitor exposures in real time, stress test for extreme scenarios, and continually refine our process as market structure evolves.

Square Kettle is a company founded to develop theories surrounding global derivatives markets and quant trading. Our members are passionate about our hypotheses and meticulous in our implementation. We primarily trade derivatives products, prediction markets, and a broad range of asset classes, utilizing a responsible amount of leverage to capture risk premiums and generate strong, consistent returns.
Square Kettle | Quant Trading & Systematic Strategies in Global Derivatives

Through our interactions with institutions in East Asia, we're able to model our markets and systems by using empirical analysis to uncover patterns and predict cyclical behaviors. Our research is designed to be implemented and adapted as quickly as the markets move.
We believe in the power of collaboration. There is a limited hierarchy; we want information and ideas to have equal weight, regardless of who presents them when they end up on the floor.
We believe that traders who can effectively apply mathematics and market psychology will be able to outperform the market and mitigate tail risks.

We engineer, test, and trade systematic strategies across global markets. Our edge combines quantitative research, market intuition, and disciplined risk management in quant trading and global derivatives.
We trade. We research. We build. We're here to question why the market moves the way it does.

We value integrity and honesty. Square Kettle is a company that believes in transparent communication with its associates, clients, and other stakeholders. We conduct our operations in a manner that is safe, responsible, and held to the highest moral standards.

We want all of our employees to grow during their stay at Square Kettle. The markets are constantly changing, so are we. Stagnation is the death of any professional, especially in an industry as fast-paced as ours.

The ideal candidate has deep expertise in statistical modeling and machine learning, with a strong inclination toward translating research insights into robust, monetizable trading systems. Production & Post-Trade Analysis:Analyze live trading performance, conduct post-trade diagnostics, and continuously optimize models to maximize risk-adjusted returns. Collaboration:Work closely with trading and engineering teams to enhance research methodologies, data pipelines, and infrastructure while contributing to a strong culture of knowledge sharing. What We’re Looking For Experience:Strong background in statistical modeling, machine learning, and data analysis applied to real-world problems. Programming Skills:Proficiency in Python, C++, R, or similar languages, with hands-on experience using libraries and frameworks such as NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. Education:A degree in a quantitative discipline such as Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, AI/ML, or a related field. Core Skills: Excellent problem-solving ability with a strong mathematical and statistical foundation Experience working with time-series data, financial markets, and market microstructure Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with traders and engineers

Technology plays a crucial role here at Aspect. Sunny Ratilal, Developer, discusses what it takes to be a good developer, why there are no Business Analysts at the firm and what this means for the Development team and their approach.
The Software Development Team designs, builds and maintains Aspect’s highly automated execution systems which runs from front office trading to back office reconcilliations.

The development process is agile, highly collaborative and focuses heavily on continuous improvement. Daily stand-ups, retrospectives, pairing and TDD are standard. We are always experimenting with new technologies, techniques and ways of working. We hone our craft by participating in and hosting software community events. We also attend conferences and engage directly with thought-leaders in various technical disciplines.

The trading systems are Java-based. Back end systems include SQL Server, JMS and distributed caching technologies. We use IntelliJ and Git when developing. Our tools and processes are designed to ensure we produce software of the highest quality and deliver it to production safely and efficiently. For example, we have built a highly automated continuous integration, continuous delivery and automated testing system using Git and TeamCity that we are constantly evolving.

We are always on the lookout for talented generalists to join our team who are interested in working with a broad range of technologies with a view to enhancing their careers in an open and engaging environment.

We love our office and truly believe in the importance of face‑to‑face collaboration and connection in shaping and sustaining our culture. At the same time, we recognise the importance of flexibility and its role in supporting wellbeing and mental health. As with all things, it’s about balance: we typically expect people to work from the office at least three days a week, with flexibility on the remaining days to work in the way that enables them to be most productive.
